mods.name: NotClickable
mods.description:
NotClickable is a Minecraft Forge mod for 1.20.1 that lets you mark blocks as unclickable and prevents players from interacting with them.

It’s useful for adventure maps, server regions, and protected structures.

Features:
- Block any right-click interactions on specific blocks
- Mark or unmark blocks via /notclickable command
- Use /notclickable list to view all protected blocks
- Highlight marked blocks with a glowing particle outline
